notes.title: Free Music Update on Sept 24 — Shirobon + Future Funk Squad
notes.content:
Hi all,



On September 24th I'll be updating all versions of Beat Hazard to include some great new tracks.



First we have 5 amazing chip-tune tracks from Shirobon



I've also been working with Future Funk Squad who have worked with Nine Inch Nails, Sia and U2. They have made an exclusive track for Beat Hazard, and I'm really excited for everyone to play it. I'm so privileged to be able to work with a top flight artist!



On Sept 24th, Beat Hazard returns to PlayStation. Details here 


I'm gaging interest on a Steam release of Beat Hazard Arcade. It would have full VR support, and be a streamlined Arcade Beat Hazard experience. It would have some new weapons and enemies, and focus on community leaderboards. I'm interested to hear some feedback. 


Happy Hazarding!

Cheers,

Steve.

notes.title: Leaderboard system update
notes.content:
Hi all,

The update contains a big change to the leader board system. I've had to re-code all the system calls due to an update in AWS code. 

Hopefully, you won't notice any difference. But if there are any score related issues, please report them to the bugs forum.

Cheers,
Steve,

PS. this AWS change also affects BH2 VR, BH3, MAB on PC & Mobile, so I'll be rolling out the same changes to those games as I get them updated. I have my hands full!

notes.title: New Zen+ difficulty and gameplay update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33564160/d9b34d7d1b8ead34dc8dd8971a6dd97ae37d8afe.jpg

Hi all,

A new update has just dropped that adds a new difficulty level. Gameplay improvements have been made and a number of major bugs have been fixed:

Gameplay:
- Zen+ difficulty. More ships. +30% enemy HP. Good luck!
- Each player ship can now have only 1 Start Multiplier. This has been offset be increasing the value gained from the 'More Multiplier' perk. 
- Ship stats have been re-balanced. This means most player ships should 'feel' better. However, because of the way the procedural system works, some ships might need a 're-roll' and therefore might change quite a bit.

Bug fixes:
- Hangar screen can now handle unlimited ships. 
- Random crash on Game Over screen should now be fixed.

Stats:
- Press 'D' in the options screen will dump your high score data to the debug.txt file. Handy to find the tracks with the best / highest score rate.

A big thank you to Ceph and the players on the discord server for suggestions, feedback and testing.

Cheers,
Steve

notes.title: V1.043
notes.content:
Note: These changes have required a reset of the per song scores and per song leaderboards. 

- Added Global recent tracks list. Here you can see the recent tracks other people have been playing
- Click on the 'copy to clipboard' to copy the track details to the clipboard. You can then paste this in Spotify, or elsewhere, to quickly find that track.
- Track hashing is now less picky. All tracks are now and lower case and will match on a duration of +/- 5 seconds. (This change of hash system is the reason for the per song score reset as track will now map ti different hash values)
- Tried to improve open mic detection success. The code now listens for 15s instead of the previous 8s.
- Open Mic tracks should now spawn the same as local tracks given the same song.


Note: The result of the next feature vote was Articulated Bosses. So that will be the next major feature I'll be working on.

notes.title: V1.001 Update
notes.content:
Hi all, new build is up:

I've tried to address the open mic problems some players are having:

- Fixed crash when using 'Open Mic Settings'

- All 'loopback' audio devices are now added to the desktop audio list, this include Speakers, Headphones and Headsets

- Added warning if input device has > 2 channels. It will still play, but the ID system doesn't currently work with surround sound.

- Added a warning if input frequency is > 48khz. If you get this warning, can you report back is the track ID system worked?

Steve
